atfbooru is being taken down and since a lot of this artist's stuff is only on there, I figured it was time for there to be a collection of all her work on here. For completeness sake the colored version of her art (colored by putafedo) is also here.

pages 1-5: Intro Comic 1
pages 6-16: Intro Comic 2
pages 17-22: Intro Comic 1 (colored)
pages 23-31: Intro Comic 2 (colored)
pages 32-34: Dophi x Kyoppai the Oppai Loli
pages 35-56: Baby Changing Station
pages 57-68: Young Dophi x Best Friend (in progress)
pages 69-76: miscellaneous other art
